newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA V AUSTRALIA TOSS/TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA V AUSTRALIA TOSS/TEAMS.

text.p: Australia won the toss and chose to bat first in the fourth one-day international against South Africa at Kingsmead on Saturday.
South Africa - Adam Bacher, Herschelle Gibbs, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Jonty Rhodes, Derek Crookes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Rudi Bryson, Allan Donald.
Australia - Michael di Venuto, Stuart Law, Greg Blewett, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Adam Gilchrist, Ian Healy (captain), Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Adam Dale, Jason Gillespie.
